note: Questions and information needed before any decision can reasonably be made. Each row says what is known (verified), what is missing, and how to close the gap.

questions.question: Is sports betting legal for you in Mexico City, and is wagering the goal, or is it research only?
questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether any line or strategy work has a real-money use, and what compliance applies.
questions.known_verified: User location: Mexico City, MX (from user profile).
questions.missing: Official Mexican regulator position; the user's stated goal.
questions.how_to_close: Check the official gambling regulator (SEGOB, Dirección General de Juegos y Sorteos) and confirm the goal in writing.

questions.question: What does 'reward' mean in the strategy leaderboard: points on this site, or money?
questions.why_it_matters: A money reward changes legal and responsible-gambling requirements; points do not.
questions.known_verified: Task text says 'rewards for top performing strategies' without defining it.

questions.question: Which markets are in scope first: point spread, total, moneyline, player props, parlays?
questions.why_it_matters: Each market needs different data, different validation, and different correlation handling.
questions.known_verified: Task names single bets, parlays, and player prop combos.
questions.how_to_close: Recommend starting with spreads only (fewest data needs). User decision.

questions.question: Which source for historical closing lines and odds, and is its licence allowed for this use?
questions.why_it_matters: Closing line value and ROI can only be measured against real odds. No official NFL source publishes lines.
questions.known_verified: No verified odds source. nflverse schedule file (contains line fields) could not be downloaded here.
questions.missing: A licensed or open odds archive with terms of use.
questions.how_to_close: Check nflverse data terms and any odds vendor licence. Do not scrape sportsbook sites without permission.

questions.question: How many seasons of history should the validation use?
questions.why_it_matters: Sample size drives whether a result can be separated from luck.
questions.how_to_close: Decide with user; collect from NFL.com schedules and results.

questions.question: Where are official depth charts published, so starters and backups can be identified per team and week?
questions.why_it_matters: Required to answer 'which backup replaced which starter' for offense and defense.
questions.known_verified: NFL.com team roster pages exist and show position and status (sampled BUF roster page 1 of 3). Depth chart page not yet located or fetched.
questions.missing: Confirmed official depth-chart URL and its structure.
questions.how_to_close: Fetch the NFL.com team depth chart page for one team, confirm structure, then repeat for 32 teams.

questions.question: Should 'Not injury related' designations (e.g., resting player, personal matter) be excluded from injury analysis?
questions.why_it_matters: Four Week 10 players have these labels: Jessie Bates, Jordan Davis, Azeez Al-Shaair, Myles Garrett.
questions.known_verified: The NFL.com report labels them 'Not injury related' in the injury column.
questions.missing: User preference for how to treat them.
questions.how_to_close: Recommend excluding them from injury counts and showing them separately. User decision.

questions.question: How often should the site refresh (manual, daily, or before each game day)?
questions.why_it_matters: Injury statuses change before kickoff; a stale table can mislead.
questions.known_verified: Report was fetched on 2026-11-14 for Week 10.
questions.missing: Refresh schedule and an owner for it.
questions.how_to_close: User decision. Automation would need repo permission for scheduled jobs.

questions.question: Is the site public or private?
questions.why_it_matters: Public pages with betting-related content have different risk and legal exposure.
questions.known_verified: Task asks for a GitHub Pages live site.
questions.how_to_close: User decision. Current build is public Pages.

questions.question: Does the user have a bankroll and loss limit in mind, and what is the time horizon?
questions.why_it_matters: Needed for responsible-gambling guardrails and for any staking model.
questions.how_to_close: User input. Do not set values for the user.

questions.question: Is the repository meant to be public, and under what license?
questions.why_it_matters: The repo has no license and no code (see F-01).
questions.known_verified: Repo is at github.com/sassnarep3-star/FL2; README only.

questions.question: Which NFL.com page confirms the weekly injury-report timing (when each report is posted)?
questions.why_it_matters: Needed to schedule refresh and know which status is current.
questions.known_verified: Week 10 report shows 'Week 10 of the 2026 Season' and game times, but posting schedule is not shown on the fetched content.
questions.how_to_close: Find the NFL.com injury report policy page and confirm wording.
